title: The Moon and the Stars Cottage- in town!
description:
Calm and peaceful- Privately located in the back of my property in the quiet urban neighborhood of Sylvan Park . Minutes away from great food, parks and all of the  downtown landmarks. One of the most iconic Nashville neighborhoods.

We sanitize the full space after each stay. All surfaces wiped down.

The space
This lovely cottage was built  in the early 1900's...nicely updated, but it still retains its charming feel. Enjoy the plush Stearns and Foster pillow top mattress while watching a full cable line up including HBO . Cook a meal in the full size eat in kitchen or walk to Hattie B's hot chicken (order mild for first timers!), Hugh Baby's burgers and BBQ, Park Cafe, Star Bagel and more.

Guest access
Play fetch with my lovely Australian Shepard!

Other things to note
Having performed on The Grand Ole Opry, The Country Music Hall of Fame and The Bluebird....I can give you an insider's view of Nashville and it's amazing music scene.
